watch.summary: A streamer begs an opponent in Rocket League to stop hitting him, only to be instantly demolished.

beats.what: Streamer drives around questioning another player's play style.
Streamer notices the opponent is target-bumping him.
He pleads 'Can you stop doing that, please, bro?'
His car gets instantly blown up with a 'BOOM!' screen effect.
Streamer sits in silent disbelief while respawning.

watch.author: opponent
watch.key_line: Can you stop doing that, please, bro?
watch.why: The instant ironic payoff of getting blown up right after asking the opponent to stop creates great comedic timing. The streamer's quiet, stunned silence afterwards completes the joke.
